fact: ARN published the report of Public Consultation No. 2, launched on 4 June 2026 on the draft radio-fee order, recording the contribution received from Orange Bissau, which proposals it accepted and its reasoned rejection of the 3,500 MHz fee reduction.
title: ARN publica Relatório da Consulta Pública n.º 2 sobre o Projeto de Despacho das Taxas Radioelétricas
publisher: Autoridade Reguladora Nacional das Tecnologias de Informação e Comunicação (ARN)
